Property description

Council Tax A fee submitted to your local authority to cover expenses related to local amenities such as schools, libraries, and waste management. The payment amount is determined based on the property's value. Read our glossary page :  

ASK AGENT

Available Date Refers to the date on which a property or rental unit becomes available for occupancy. Read our glossary page

ASK AGENT

Available from 15th August is this amazing two bedroom apartment for rent, ideally positioned in the desirable central location of Royal Mint Street, E1. Boasting a luxury bespoke open plan Kitchen with integrated appliances, stylish decor and flooring throughout, a Private Balcony accessed by both lounge and bedroom and it features a contemporary bathroom suite and great storage. The development benefits from fantastic facilities including a 24-hour concierge service, resident's gymnasium, yoga room, jacuzzi, relaxing communal lounge area and cinema room along with gorgeous landscaped Gardens with impressive water features. The property is conveniently positioned just moments from Tower Gateway DLR and just short walking distance to Tower Hill and Aldgate/ Aldgate East Underground Stations and Fenchurch Street Rail. Amazing apartment, incredible opportunity. Call now for viewings. (Council Tax - Band E / EPC Rating C)
